// The language the mod speaks: picked from the person's choice, else the
// system's, else English. Pure: the hooks gather the candidates, this decides.

import { de } from './de'
import { en, type Key } from './en'
import { es } from './es'
import { fr } from './fr'
import { hi } from './hi'
import { it } from './it'
import { ja } from './ja'
import { ko } from './ko'
import { pt } from './pt'
import { ru } from './ru'
import { zh } from './zh'

export type { Key }
export type Lang = 'en' | 'it' | 'es' | 'fr' | 'de' | 'pt' | 'zh' | 'ja' | 'ru' | 'ko' | 'hi'
export const LANGS: readonly Lang[] = ['en', 'it', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'pt', 'zh', 'ja', 'ru', 'ko', 'hi']
export const DICTS: Record<Lang, Record<string, string>> = { en, it, es, fr, de, pt, zh, ja, ru, ko, hi }

export type Vars = Record<string, string | number>
export type T = (key: Key, vars?: Vars) => string

const NAMES: Record<string, Lang> = {
  english: 'en',
  italian: 'it',
  italiano: 'it',
  spanish: 'es',
  espanol: 'es',
  español: 'es',
  french: 'fr',
  francais: 'fr',
  français: 'fr',
  german: 'de',
  deutsch: 'de',
  portuguese: 'pt',
  portugues: 'pt',
  português: 'pt',
  chinese: 'zh',
  中文: 'zh',
  简体中文: 'zh',
  japanese: 'ja',
  日本語: 'ja',
  russian: 'ru',
  русский: 'ru',
  korean: 'ko',
  한국어: 'ko',
  hindi: 'hi',
  हिन्दी: 'hi',
}

/**
 * The first candidate that names a supported language: a locale ("it-IT",
 * "it_IT.UTF-8", "zh-Hans-CN"), a list ("it:en") or a language name ("italiano").
 * Candidates come in order of authority; nothing usable means English.
 */
export function pickLang(candidates: readonly (string | undefined | null)[]): Lang {
  for (const raw of candidates) {
    const first = String(raw ?? '')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .split(/[-_.@:,;\s]/)[0]
    if (!first || first === 'c' || first === 'posix') continue
    if ((LANGS as readonly string[]).includes(first)) return first as Lang
    if (NAMES[first]) return NAMES[first]
  }
  return 'en'
}

/**
 * Which form of a plural to use. A language with one form (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) has no
 * plural; Russian has three (1, 2-4, 5+); French and Hindi count 0 and 1 as singular.
 */
export function pluralIndex(lang: Lang, n: number, forms: number): number {
  if (forms <= 1) return 0
  if (lang === 'ru' && forms >= 3) {
    const m10 = n % 10
    const m100 = n % 100
    return m10 === 1 && m100 !== 11 ? 0 : m10 >= 2 && m10 <= 4 && (m100 < 12 || m100 > 14) ? 1 : 2
  }
  const one = lang === 'fr' || lang === 'hi' ? n >= 0 && n < 2 : n === 1
  return one ? 0 : 1
}

/** The decimal mark a language writes between 9 and 6 in 9.6k. */
export const decimalFor = (lang: Lang): string => (['en', 'zh', 'ja', 'ko', 'hi'].includes(lang) ? '.' : ',')

export function translate(lang: Lang, key: Key, vars: Vars = {}): string {
  let text = DICTS[lang]?.[key] ?? en[key] ?? key
  if (text.includes('|') && typeof vars.n === 'number') {
    const parts = text.split('|')
    text = parts[pluralIndex(lang, vars.n, parts.length)] ?? parts[0]
  }
  return text.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (whole, name: string) => (name in vars ? String(vars[name]) : whole))
}

export const makeT =
  (lang: Lang): T =>
  (key, vars) =>
    translate(lang, key, vars)

import type { Nav } from '../../types'
import type { Req } from '../session'
import type { Act } from './context'

/**
 * The closures a drawing calls. The hook that draws owns `$`, so it hands over two plain
 * functions (send a request to the controller, change where the person is in the panel) and
 * everything else is built from them here.
 */
export const makeAct = (send: (req: Req) => void, go: (change: (nav: Nav) => Nav) => void): Act => ({
  // Moving between tabs or sets closes what was open, so the panel stays short.
  tab: tab => go(n => ({ ...n, tab, info: null, opt: false, keep: [] })),
  open: id => go(n => ({ ...n, open: n.open === id ? null : id, info: null })),
  info: key => go(n => ({ ...n, info: n.info === key ? null : key })),
  adv: id => go(n => ({ ...n, adv: n.adv === id ? null : id })),
  opt: open => go(n => ({ ...n, opt: open, keep: open ? n.keep : [] })),
  keep: key => go(n => ({ ...n, keep: n.keep.includes(key) ? n.keep.filter(k => k !== key) : [...n.keep, key] })),
  tighten: () => {
    go(n => ({ ...n, tab: 'chat', info: null }))
    send({ op: 'tighten' })
  },
  inherit: keys => send({ op: 'inherit', keys }),
  decline: () => send({ op: 'decline' }),
  gtools: () => go(n => ({ ...n, gtools: !n.gtools })),
  advAll: () => go(n => ({ ...n, advOn: !n.advOn })),
  find: text => go(n => ({ ...n, find: text.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 60), info: null })),
  more: id => go(n => ({ ...n, more: n.more === id ? null : id })),
  tech: key => go(n => ({ ...n, tech: n.tech === key ? null : key })),
  plugin: (id, isOn) => send({ op: 'plugin', id, isOn }),
  skill: (name, mode) => send({ op: 'skill', name, mode }),
  set: change => send({ op: 'set', ...change }),
  dim: () => send({ op: 'dim' }),
  undo: () => send({ op: 'undo' }),
  ask: text => send({ op: 'ask', text: text.replace(/\s+/g, ' ') }),
  cancel: () => send({ op: 'cancel' }),
  clear: () => send({ op: 'clear' }),
  accept: () => send({ op: 'accept' }),
  dismiss: () => send({ op: 'dismiss' }),
  show: () => send({ op: 'open' }),
  pref: (key, value) => send({ op: 'pref', key, value }),
  lighter: () => {
    go(n => ({ ...n, tab: 'chat', info: null }))
    send({ op: 'lighter' })
  },
  update: id => send({ op: 'update', id }),
  lang: lang => send({ op: 'lang', lang }),
})

// The one line that is always on screen: how full Claude's memory is, what is running, and the way in.
// Quiet by design: it says nothing a glance does not need. In a narrow pane it wraps onto a second line.

import { trunc } from '../format'
import { C } from '../theme'
import type { ViewContext } from './context'
import { flow, meter } from './kit'
import { hotkey, primary } from './style'

export function Band({ ui, width, data, act, t, surface }: ViewContext) {
  const { Text, Button } = ui
  const { snap, hint, pending } = data.core
  const tone = snap && snap.percent >= 85 ? C.bad : snap && snap.percent >= 60 ? C.warn : C.ok
  const memory = snap ? (snap.hasUsage ? t('band.memory', { pct: Math.round(snap.percent) }) : t('band.memoryNone')) : t('band.measuring')

  return flow(ui, [
    <Text color={C.brand} bold>
      {'◆ Pitwall'}
    </Text>,
    <Button key="open" label={t('band.open')} hotkey={hotkey(surface, 'p')} variant={primary(surface)} onPress={() => act.show()} />,
    ...(snap && snap.hasUsage ? [meter(ui, surface, snap.percent, 100, 8, tone)] : []),
    <Text color={snap && snap.percent >= 60 ? tone : undefined} dimColor={!snap || snap.percent < 60} wrap="wrap">
      {memory}
    </Text>,
    ...(pending.length > 0 ? [<Text color={C.warn}>{t('band.pending', { n: pending.length })}</Text>] : []),
    ...(hint
      ? [
          <Text color={C.warn} wrap="wrap">{`▲ ${trunc(hint.text, 80)}`}</Text>,
          <Button key="hint-yes" label={t('band.turnOn')} variant={primary(surface)} onPress={() => act.accept()} />,
          <Button key="hint-no" label={t('band.dismiss')} plain dimColor onPress={() => act.dismiss()} />,
        ]
      : []),
  ])
}
